submission.natural_language_explanation: This head acts retrospectively on the content word immediately following a category-selecting function word, attending back to that function word with weight ~0.9; it fires strongest on the degree adjective/adverb after interrogative/exclamative how (how much/rapidly/deeply/fond), and more weakly on parallel to+verb, when+verb/participle and both+noun bigrams.

rival_explanations: This is a generic previous-token head that fires about equally on any token following any frequent function word (of, the, in, and), so how confers no special advantage over e.g. of the or in the.
This is strictly an exclamative-degree how plus adjective/adverb detector, so infinitive to plus verb, both plus noun and when plus verb bigrams stay below the active line even when adjacent.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The when and the where remain unclear to all of us.
